name: Khelo India Athletes (KIA / E-KIA) support under the Khelo India Scheme (2026-27 to 2030-31)
provider: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Department of Sports (via Sports Authority of India)

rules.value: athletes enter as KIA/E-KIA by meeting sport-specific benchmarks and being recommended by TIDC and approved by HPC
rules.quote: Athletes who meet the approved protocols and benchmarks.

rules.value: benefit is by selection/induction, not an open application
rules.quote: Athlete recommended by TIDC and approved by HPC as per suitable criteria in sports specific protocols.

rules.value: athletes must be registered on Khel Setu
rules.quote: All the athletes in Khelo India Training Facilities shall be mandatorily registered on Khel Setu.

Each KIA/E-KIA shall be eligible for training, competition, boarding and lodging, sports kit, sports science, equipment, education, medical & insurance support etc. as per approved funding norms and suitable Out of Pocket Allowance (OPA).

amount.text: Training, boarding/lodging, kit, education, medical and insurance support plus Out of Pocket Allowance paid by DBT; amounts per DPAC-approved norms (not stated in guidelines)
amount.quote: Out-of-Pocket Allowance (OPA) for the athletes, remuneration of the coaches and support staff engaged under this scheme and other admissible athlete-centric support

deadline.text: No application window; induction through assessment camps and TIDC recommendation
